title: Extension Fee Rule for Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
**Para. 1 — Charge.** The extension fee on a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers is charged to the holder as a separate fee entry on the credit. It is waived when the customer's Summit tier in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program waives credit service fees, and a waived fee is not recorded.

**Para. 2 — Amount.** The extension fee is one amount in US dollars to the cent. It is the fee basis multiplied once by the combined rate, and only that product is rounded to the nearest cent.

**Para. 3 — Fee basis.** The fee basis is the instrument's extension fee, as a flat amount.

**Para. 4 — Combined rate.** The combined rate is one figure: the extension-fee rates multiplied with one another. A combined rate of 1 leaves the fee equal to its basis.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Condition | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| The customer's Summit tier waives credit service fees | the fee is waived | no fee entry is recorded |
| The customer's Summit tier does not waive credit service fees | the fee is charged | one fee entry for the fee basis multiplied once by the combined rate, rounded to the cent |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

On an instrument whose extension fee is 99 US dollars, with a combined rate of 1, the fee is 99 multiplied by 1, which is 99.00. It is charged to the holder as one fee entry on the credit.
